title: How a16z-backed DATA is rethinking its blockchain strategy after $30 million Sui deal
summary: The startup is retiring its own blockchain and moving to Sui with a $30 million investment as it narrows its focus to AI training data.

title: Bybit will look for big broker partnerships to take on Robinhood in the U.S.
summary: When it comes to the U.S., Bybit will look to work with with someone like Interactive Brokers (IB), for example, said CEO Ben Zhou.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Why real-world assets need fixed-rate loans onchain
summary: Real-world assets already back the largest stablecoins, yet borrowing against them onchain still runs through variable-rate pools. Peter Gaffney of O2O Capital Partners explains why fixed-rate, fixed-term lending is the missing piece, and how a 5% shift in Sky and Ethena reserves could create $1.8 billion of demand for real-world assets.

title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
summary: Vault12 raised $17.45 million selling VGT in 2018 and says it met or dropped every promise, yet the token has never traded on a centralized exchange.

title: Japanese visitors may be able to pay with yen stablecoins in South Korea under Shinhan-SBI pact
summary: The collaboration will explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea and peer-to-peer wallet transfers among broader cross-border trade remittances.
